source_title: Open Agent Ecosystem — Having an AI Engineer at Your Fingertips
speaker: Merve Noyan (MVA) — ML Engineer at HuggingFace (open source team)
key_insight: Open agent stack is now production-usable: GLM 5.1 leads SWE-bench Pro, Hermes agent claims memory-management improvements over OpenClaw, HF Hub ships MCP + Skills + local agent + traces-dataset repo type — answering our fallback, privacy, and cost concerns.

discovered_urls.context: Hermes agent — Merve's 'die on this hill' local coding agent; claimed 'step beyond OpenClaw by means of memory management'; setup wizard + Slack/WhatsApp integration + one-command install; Merve autonomously fixed a Slack-integration issue using GLM 5.1 + Hermes agent
HF blog post or announcement page for Hermes agent — secondary entry point; verify exact URL
llama.cpp now ships llama-agent as a binary — just pass a HF hub ID and it runs a full coding agent loop. Zero-setup local agent primitive

discovered_urls.context: GLM 5.1 — currently top of SWE-bench Pro; Merve's personal coding-setup model; open-source model catching up to closed; primary non-Anthropic fallback candidate for our orchestrator

HF Hub MCP server — plug the entire Hub into any LLM/harness; native Hub integration

NEW HF Hub dataset repo type for agent traces — hosts Codex/Claude Code/Pi traces, parsed into a traces column in the dataset viewer; you can train models on your own sessions; Hermes agent integration coming soon; directly relevant to our orchestrator session logging strategy

Dynamic HF Spaces MCP — any HF space becomes a callable agent tool; demo: 'generate image of baklava made of yarn' routed to Qwen Image space; on-demand image/audio/video tools for agents
NEW HF Buckets product — S3-like object storage, cheaper/faster than S3, mountable; absorbed intermediate storage for Niels's 30K-paper OCR workflow; relevant storage layer for large agent workloads
Chandra OCR — currently top of ALM OCR bench; default recommendation from new HF OCR skill; relevant for document-processing pipelines (research librarian, client PDF ingestion)
